overview_description.description: MarqVision is an AI-powered brand protection platform that helps companies detect and remove counterfeit products from online marketplaces. It assists brands in detecting and removing infringing listings from global online marketplaces infiltrated by counterfeiters using its machine learning technology. Its technology also helps clients to efficiently protect their sales and reputation from intellectual property infringement. It serves industries including fashion, luxury goods, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics.

about_short_description.short_description: MarqVision is an AI Services Platform for Global Brands. We provide brand protection, brand establishment and brand intelligence services.

product.name: Brand Protection
product.description: AI-powered monitoring and enforcement for counterfeit products and trademark infringements across online marketplaces, social platforms, websites, and app stores.

product.name: Content Protection
product.description: AI-based anti-piracy monitoring and enforcement for digital content, software, apps, games, and online services across websites, search engines, social platforms, and marketplaces.

product.name: Impersonation
product.description: Monitoring and takedown service for fake domains, phishing sites, fraudulent ads, spoofed social accounts, and website content impersonating a brand or its representatives.

product.name: Unauthorized Sales
product.description: Channel-monitoring service for identifying gray-market sellers, tracking SKU-level prices, and assessing seller compliance across online sales channels.

product.name: MarqLaw
product.description: Legal and offline enforcement services for intellectual-property violations, including investigations, customs and criminal enforcement, raids, litigation support, and revenue recovery.

product.name: Trademark Management
product.description: Centralized trademark filing and portfolio-management service for registering, renewing, monitoring, and managing intellectual-property applications and records.
